question: 1889–1986 is coded all-White on the "first Black member since Reconstruction" framing, and the five Reconstruction-era members rest on Hjerpe's reading of the 1880 manuscript census. What supports the default? Seven members before 1912 appear in O'Leary by initials only; the 1880-1910 census sheets give five of them a first name and all six found a gender, Male (Torreyson is A. question: What body governed Alexandria County between retrocession and 1870? The Virginia pattern is a county court of justices of the peace doing the administrative work alongside the judicial, elected by district after the 1851 constitution, but nothing held says so for this county. The claim matters because it is what makes 1870 the start of the series: not the point where the data begins, but the first time the county has an elected body of this kind at all.
settles: A county history or a Virginia local-government source stating the composition and powers of Alexandria County's court in that period, and whether its justices were appointed or elected.
